summary: The Student Employment Application document is designed to manage and submit student employment applications within the HSPnet framework. It provides a user interface for displaying student information, educational program details, employer site details, and application submission functionalities.
purpose: To facilitate the submission and management of student employment applications, including document handling, placement history, and communication with recruitment contacts.

workflows.name: Student Employment Application Submission
steps: Bind employment application data to the form view header.
Determine if the screen is editable based on user session and application state.
Display submission panel and documents tab based on user permissions and page state.
Submit application data via command button.
Send notification email to recruitment contact if available.

business_rules: Screen is editable only for system administrators or if the user session's staff ID matches the application's student ID.
Submission panel is visible only if the staff ID matches the student ID of the application.
History tab is enabled only if release history is true.
system_behavior: Auto-generates fields and controls using backend code.
Sets up page environment and user session during page load and unload events.
Handles page messages through process functions in pre-render events.
exceptions: If recruitment contact email is not available, a warning message is added.
Errors in sending email result in error messages being logged.
